description: This file defines the main layout component for a Qwik-based frontend application, incorporating navigation logic, user authentication state management, and including components like TopBar and Sidebar.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Defines a Qwik component for the application layout.

methods.name: useVisibleTask$
methods.description: Sets up a side effect to check authentication token and user info on component visibility.

methods.name: useSignal
methods.description: Creates reactive signals, specifically for storing user email.

methods.name: nav
methods.description: Navigates programmatically within the app, using Qwik's useNavigate.

methods.name: onLogout$
methods.description: Handles user logout by calling the logout function and redirecting to auth page.
